records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Partners
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Glad to have Cedar Partners on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone; customer no-showed the onboarding call [calendar:f143352a], already asked about cancelling at cycle end (tick_ecc4cd33d349), and has an open badge ticket [email:a7491126]. Low engagement plus churn intent makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: Picking up where we left off, Dara
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for your patience on the notification badge ticket 
instead 
-- that one's still open on my side and I'll follow up there with an update.

On the account itself: nothing has been set up yet, and I'd rather that not be the reason Wrenfield feels like extra work. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually all it takes for the rest to click.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to sit with you while you set up that first project, or just answer questions if that's easier.

Best,
Priya
